{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Employee Satisfaction Index", "construction": "Derived from publically available employee review websites like Glassdoor. Normalized by industry.", "rationale": "Companies with happier employees might be more productive, leading to higher profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Social Media Sentiment", "construction": "Aggregate sentiment of posts about the company on social media platforms, computed using natural language processing techniques.", "rationale": "Positive social media sentiment might indicate strong brand and customer loyalty, which could drive higher sales and earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "CEO Market Confidence", "construction": "Calculated from the ratio of CEO's publicly disclosed holdings of company stock to total compensation.", "rationale": "A CEO who holds a large proportion of her wealth in company stock might have high confidence in her company's future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Customer Churn", "construction": "Obtained from industry reports and third-party data providers. Normalized by industry.", "rationale": "High customer churn might signal dissatisfaction with a company's products or services, potentially hurting future sales and earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Corporate Social Responsibility Rating", "construction": "Scores obtained from corporate social responsibility rating agencies.", "rationale": "Companies with high CSR ratings may have better relationships with stakeholders, which could support strong performance.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Product Pipeline", "construction": "Number of products in development or awaiting regulatory approval, obtained from company reports. Relevant for certain sectors like pharmaceuticals.", "rationale": "A robust product pipeline might suggest strong future earnings potential.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Cybersecurity Risk Score", "construction": "Scores obtained from cybersecurity rating services.", "rationale": "Companies with high cybersecurity risk may face costly breaches and reputational damage, potentially hurting future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Foreign Sales Ratio", "construction": "Foreign sales divided by total sales, calculated from company filings.", "rationale": "Companies with higher foreign sales might benefit from geographic diversification and growth in emerging markets.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "R&D Intensity", "construction": "R&D expenditure divided by sales, calculated from company filings.", "rationale": "High R&D intensity might indicate innovation potential, which could lead to strong future earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Corporate Governance Score", "construction": "Scores obtained from corporate governance rating agencies.", "rationale": "Better governed companies might make more shareholder-friendly decisions, supporting higher stock prices.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"}
]}
